outcome: Frequency of various placental phenotypes (e.g., decidual arteriolopathy, microscopic chorionic pseudocysts, chorangiosis)
cohort: 5248 placentas from pregnancies over 20 weeks gestation
finding: Hypertensive conditions of pregnancy may obscure the underlying preuterine placental hypoxic pattern in maternal diabetes mellitus placentas.
mod_finding: Cesarean section rate was more common in pregnancies complicated by maternal diabetes mellitus compared to controls.
